name: prompt-enhancer
description: Chrome extension that rewrites the prompt in the focused text field into a clearer prompt, using your own Groq API key.

scripts.test:e2e: node scripts/build.mjs && node scripts/build.mjs --test && playwright test
scripts.screenshots: node scripts/build.mjs && node scripts/build.mjs --test && SCREENSHOTS=1 playwright test screens production-load
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test && npm run build && node scripts/check-dist.mjs
scripts.package: node scripts/build.mjs && node scripts/check-dist.mjs && node scripts/package.mjs
